newsitem.title: USA: FirstEnergy rate cuts start at $3month.
newsitem.headline: FirstEnergy rate cuts start at $3month.

text.p: FirstEnergy Corp , the holding company created by the merger of Ohio Edison Co and Centerior Energy Corp, said Friday it will file for a rate cut to take effect after the merger.
The plan would cut residential electric bills by $3 a month initially, increasing to $4 a month on July 1, 2000 and then to $5 a month from July 1, 2001 through the year 2005, FirstEnergy said.

FirstEnergy said the plan also would provide interim rate cuts for certain commercial customers and the write-off $2 billion in nuclear and regulatory assets of the Cleveland Electric Illuminating Co through 2005.
Cleveland Electric and Toledo Edison Co are operating companies of Centerior Energy.

Effective January 1, 2006, base rates for all Cleveland Electric and Toledo Edison customers would be cut by $310 million a year, a drop of about 15 percent from current levels, FirstEnergy said. FirstEnergy said the decrease would include a 20% cut for residential customers.
